svg.title: Neon Pelican · 霓虹鹈鹕 — 骑自行车送外卖的赛博鹈鹕 · A cyberpunk pelican riding a bicycle
svg.desc: 一只赛博朋克大白鹈鹕外卖员骑着发光的单车，穿过雨夜霓虹港城鹈鹕湾。零 JavaScript 的 SVG：骑手 4 秒无缝循环（60 rpm 下 4 圈曲柄），城市背景是一段 60 秒的旅程（霓虹街区依次掠过），还有几个彩蛋按各自的周期出现，由实时骨架逐帧烘焙为 SMIL。 A cyberpunk great white pelican courier rides a glowing bicycle through the rain-slick neon harbour city of Pelican Bay. Zero-JavaScript SVG: the rider is a seamless 4 s SMIL loop (4 crank turns at 60 rpm); the city is a 60 s journey of its own (the neon districts scroll past, set pieces come and go) and a few easter eggs drop in on their own long cycles; baked frame by frame from the live rig.
